kit_log.lidar_fix_oct20: step-1 nDSM was placed with the requested bbox; ArcGIS returned a widened extent (square pixels): trees ~45 m off, roofs on bare ground. Re-fetched with the server extent (nb_evidence.py --fetch): footprint p25 now 5.3 m median (was 0.1).
kit_log.murphys_profiles: x at z 11.6: 10.4-11.5 plateau x 64.5-76 (front+rear dormers into the hip); x at z 8: 6.0 at the front wall rising 0.74/m to 10.8 at x 70.5; z at x 70.8: plateau 10.7 z 6.5-17 (side dormers); porch roof 4.0-4.4 at x 60-63
kit_log.murphys_eave: film refit (with the far kerb line) eave edge 7.10 +-0.94 vs lidar ~6.0 at the wall line: the film is kept (evidence ladder); the lidar disposition: 0.5 m pixels at the eave mix roof and ground. Revisit: a second film camera (11626) or a day photo
kit_log.murphys_offset: the film's facade bays read 0.55 m to +z of the footprint's centre (apex residual 30 px): kept on the footprint, bays centred (DEVIATIONS)
kit_log.garage_side: the Murphys' 2022 outbuilding and drive are on the house's LEFT (-z) seen from Lincoln; step-1 notes said right

PLAN to finish: (a) extend nb_manifest's rows to every parcel fronting Lincoln within z -150..150 and the two junctions (Lincoln's fork at z -67, Pine St at z 112): about 14 more lots; complex footprints (lot_A-2/A-3, 420 m2 L-shapes) as 2-3 rectangles, not one box (they read as barns in the aerial); (b) facade cards: none needed at LOD1 (windows are framed quads); (c) the WinterNeighborhood (1410 renderers): SpecGreybox.Neighborhood switches its street, sidewalks, kerbs, houses, trees and snowy-lot ground off inside x -60..100, |z| < 150; keep its utility wires only where the film shows them (11581: overhead wires, top left); then delete the rest with Tier 4; (d) the photo dome (R 75 m, the windows' view) stands inside Tier 3: outside it must go (or grow to R ~220 m as a sky-only dome) and Tier 4 takes the horizon; (e) the inactive WinterBackdrop_NightHouse card (wrong house, film 5546) is deleted once the Murphys are in; (f) K (PropertyView) already hides everything off the lot, the Neighborhood root included
tiers.4: PLAN: a treeline ring at 160-220 m (alpha tree-silhouette cards from the lidar canopy height, 2 rows, varied), a flat overcast/clear sky (no hills: Winnetka is flat; DEVIATIONS 104), the dome's photo ground band hidden behind it

budgets._note: per view from the street (Tier 2 sidewalk, adult eye); triangles after LOD selection; measured from the generated files (build_stats.json); frame-time slot: plug the Mac standalone baseline (perf_probe.sh) in at 'baseline_ms'

tier2.tree_rule: LOD0 (120k) only above 0.55 screen height = within ~20 m: at most ~4 at once from the sidewalk; LOD1 25k, LOD2 5k; if the M3 baseline is tight: LOD0 cut to 0.75 screen (12 m)
tier2.draw_calls: ~10 per house LOD0 (one mesh, a submesh per shared material) x 5 + street 5 x 3 + lamps 2 x 10 + trees 2 x 58 = ~200 (SRP batcher: shared materials)

budgets.materials: 23 shared NB_* (one per set x colour) + 2 glass + lamp globe
budgets.texture_memory: 10 sets x (1024^2 albedo BC1 0.7 MB + normal BC5 1.3 MB + mask BC7 1.3 MB) = ~33 MB with mips; bark sets shared with the yard
budgets.lights: 10 lamp posts (point, no shadows, night) + porch lamp glows as emissive; HDRP serves <= 24 lights per frame: lamps culled past 60 m
